units.source_text: “幻影不就是手触摸不到的无形的东西吗？”

en.t: Isn't a phantom something formless that the hand cannot touch?

units.source_text: 千重子继续说着，突然涨红了脸。

en.t: Chieko went on speaking, and suddenly her face flushed red.

units.source_text: 苗子不仅是脸，恐怕全身各个部分都像自己。

en.t: Naeko resembled her not only in the face; perhaps every part of her body was like her own.

units.source_text: 她将要属于男人所有了。

en.t: She was about to belong to a man.
